text: Ethics in AI is an important topic today. AI systems can be biased if they are trained on unfair data, which may lead to wrong or harmful decisions. Fairness means AI should treat all people equally, without discrimination. Privacy is also a serious concern, because AI often collects and uses personal information. Companies must protect this data and use it safely. Transparency matters too: people should understand how AI makes decisions. Finally, responsible AI development means designers and companies must think about the social impact of their technology. They should follow clear rules and test their systems carefully. In this way, AI can help society while respecting human values and rights.
